title: Morning Sunwatch
text:
☀️ Morning Sunwatch — November 22, 2026

🔆️ Solar activity: Low (B2.7)
🔥 Latest solar flare: B4.7 (Peaked November 21, 2026 at 19:27 UTC)
💨 Solar wind speed: 376 km/s (Moderate)
🌎 Geomagnetic activity: Quiet (Kp 0.33)

A prominent dark coronal-hole region and several compact active regions are visible, while the coronagraph shows no clear large outward structure.

Image: NOAA GOES-19 SUVI — 195 Å
Data: NOAA Space Weather Prediction Center
